see.name: Burj Al Arab Helipad Tour
see.description: Exclusive access and tour of the iconic Burj Al Arab helipad with panoramic sunset views.
see.tips: Book weeks in advance; strictly VIP access.

do.name: Private VIP Desert Safari
do.description: Exclusive Range Rover desert safari, private falconry show, and a 6-course fine dining experience in a secluded desert oasis.
do.tips: Ideal for couples seeking ultimate privacy.

do.name: Luxury Yacht Charter
do.description: Charter a 100-foot luxury superyacht with a private chef, jet skis, and full crew for a day on the Arabian Gulf.
do.tips: Perfect for groups; customized menus available.

do.name: Helicopter Aerial Tour
do.description: Private helicopter flight over Palm Jumeirah, The World Islands, and Burj Khalifa.
do.tips: Bring a camera; morning flights offer the clearest skies.

do.name: Personal Shopper at The Dubai Mall
do.description: VIP buggy access and an expert personal stylist guiding you through Fashion Avenue with private fitting rooms.
do.tips: Budget does not include the cost of purchased items.

do.name: Hot Air Balloon Flight with Caviar Breakfast
do.description: Sunrise hot air balloon ride followed by a gourmet caviar and truffle breakfast.

splurge.name: Ossiano VIP Dining
splurge.description: Submersive Michelin-starred dining experience with a private scuba diver holding a personalized message in the aquarium.

splurge.name: Al Muntaha Chef's Table
splurge.description: 7-star dining at the top of the Burj Al Arab featuring the exclusive chef's tasting menu and wine pairing.
